item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.22), AMZN Bullish (+0.23)] CrowdStrike Advances 3% on Agentic Security Accelerator With Amazon and NVIDIA; Palo Alto Networks and Zscaler Gain 4%
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.22), AMZN Bullish (+0.23)
CrowdStrike launched its fourth annual startup accelerator with Amazon Web Services and NVIDIA, focusing on security for agentic AI, causing a surge in cybersecurity stocks. CrowdStrike (CRWD) rose 3%, while Palo Alto Networks (PANW) and Zscaler (ZS) both gained 4%, indicating broad market interest in AI security. Despite CRWD's 140% year-to-date increase, the accelerator doesn't directly generate revenue, making upcoming earnings reports crucial for sustaining investor enthusiasm.

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.25), AMZN Neutral (+0.14)] Alphabet Has the Biggest Upside in the Mag 7 Right Now: 64%
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bullish (+0.25), AMZN Neutral (+0.14)
Alphabet (GOOG) has received a BUY rating with a price target of $434.48, indicating a potential 27.66% upside, largely driven by Google Cloud's impressive 82% revenue growth and a significant backlog. Despite a recent capital expenditure plan that temporarily made free cash flow negative, the company's strong operating cash flow and high interest coverage limit downside risks. Alphabet's valuation, with a P/E ratio of 14, is significantly lower than its peers like Microsoft and Meta, even though its cloud growth rate is higher, suggesting a substantial upside for investors.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.33)] BorgWarner jumps as Morgan Stanley upgrades stock on AI power potential
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.33)
BorgWarner Inc. (NYSE: BWA) shares surged nearly 5% after Morgan Stanley upgraded the stock to Overweight, boosting its price target to $95 from $71. The upgrade is driven by BorgWarner's potential to capitalize on the AI infrastructure boom through its TurboCell turbine generator technology, which offers off-grid power generation for data centers. Morgan Stanley projects significant EBITDA contributions from distributed-power operations by 2030, reinforcing the company's growth beyond its traditional automotive market.

item.title: [NVDA Neutral (-0.14)] AMD’s Monster 2026 Rally Gets Fresh Fuel From Lisa Su’s 2027 AI Supply Push
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Neutral (-0.14)
Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) is positioned for continued AI-driven growth through 2027, with CEO Lisa Su announcing substantial chip supply increases and strategic partnerships to meet rising demand. The company, which saw its stock surge over 200% in 2026, is also benefiting from the increased demand for CPUs driven by AI agents. While analysts see upside, the evolving competitive landscape, particularly from NVIDIA, poses a significant challenge.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.49), AMZN Bullish (+0.32)] CrowdStrike, AWS And Nvidia Launch 4th Cybersecurity Accelerator As Agentic AI Security Push Grows
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.49), AMZN Bullish (+0.32)
CrowdStrike, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and Nvidia have launched their fourth annual Cybersecurity Startup Accelerator. The eight-week program, which runs from January 11 through March 8, 2027, aims to identify and support promising early-stage cybersecurity startups globally by providing technical mentorship, business development guidance, and access to their respective platforms and technologies. The accelerator has a successful track record, with alumni companies collectively raising nearly $1 billion in funding.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.33)] Should You Buy AbbVie Stock Before Oct. 30?
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.33)
AbbVie (NYSE:ABBV) has seen its stock rise by 17% this year, outperforming the S&P 500. The company is set to release its Q3 earnings on October 30, with expectations for strong results given its recent double-digit revenue growth and expanding drug approvals for Rinvoq and Skyrizi. Despite a high reported P/E, its forward P/E of 16 suggests it's undervalued compared to the S&P 500 average, making it an attractive investment with a solid 2.6% dividend yield.

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.46)] Are Copilot and Azure Driving the Latest Climb in Microsoft (NASDAQ:MSFT)?
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bullish (+0.46)
Microsoft (NASDAQ:MSFT) shares saw a climb after a research firm upgraded its stance, attributing the demand for its software and Copilot tools to corporate concerns about artificial intelligence. The article highlights Copilot's integration across Microsoft's product family and Azure's cloud capacity as central to the company's growth, despite increased capital spending on infrastructure. Microsoft's strong balance sheet and diversified revenue streams reinforce its blue-chip standing in a supportive market environment.

item.title: [MSFT Neutral (+0.12)] This Week: ServiceNow Automates, Atlassian Patches
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Neutral (+0.12)
This week, ServiceNow launched Flow, an AI-native service desk for Slack and Teams, designed to automate routine IT tasks and be quickly deployed. Concurrently, Atlassian issued an urgent patch for a critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-21589) affecting Jira Service Management and other Data Center products. Additionally, Vi Business expanded its managed SD-WAN offering in India through a partnership with Cisco Meraki.

item.title: [AMZN Bullish (+0.31)] Generac Surges 58% Year to Date: Is There More Room to Run?
item.description:
Sentiment: AMZN Bullish (+0.31)
Generac Holdings (GNRC) has seen its shares surge by 58% year-to-date in 2026, primarily driven by growing investor interest in its expanding data center business. The company secured a significant long-term supply agreement with Amazon for backup generators, which is expected to add substantial scale and visibility to its data center operations. Despite this growth and a strong backlog, investors are advised to consider execution risks, softness in the residential market, and potential margin implications from its changing business mix before making new investments.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.29)] Applied Materials and Intel Partner on AI Chipmaking at EPIC Center
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.29)
Applied Materials and Intel have partnered to accelerate the development of chipmaking innovations for next-generation transistors, interconnects, and advanced packaging technologies, crucial for AI computing. This collaboration links Applied's EPIC Center in Silicon Valley with Intel's R&D campus in Oregon, aiming to shorten the time-to-market for advanced semiconductor technologies. Both companies emphasize their long-standing partnership and the need for deeper collaboration to address the increasing complexity of chipmaking and drive advancements in AI computing.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.24)] Can Canopy Growth Survive Another 5 Years?
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.24)
This article questions the long-term viability of Canopy Growth (CGC) for investors. Despite hopes for future legalization in the U.S., the company continues to incur steep losses and burn through cash, raising concerns about its path to profitability. While it might survive another five years due to its ability to raise cash, an acquisition is presented as a possible future, making it a risky investment according to the author.

item.title: [AAPL Neutral (+0.07)] Apple Turned $10,000 Into Nearly $129,000. Can It Do It Again?
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Neutral (+0.07)
Apple's stock has seen incredible growth over the last decade, turning a $10,000 investment into almost $129,000. However, with its current market capitalization nearing $5 trillion, future growth is projected to be more modest. Analysts suggest that a similar investment today might only grow to about $16,500 by 2031 due to the company's massive size and increased competition.

item.title: [MSFT Neutral (+0.02)] BTIG reiterates Buy for Expedia Group stock at USD 400.00
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Neutral (+0.02)
BTIG Research has reiterated a Buy rating for Expedia Group (EXPE) stock, setting a price target of USD 400.00, which is significantly above its recent trading price. This comes after Expedia Group reported a 14% increase in second-quarter revenue and raised its full-year guidance for 2026. The company's strong operational performance and revised outlook support the analyst's positive valuation.

item.title: [AMZN Bullish (+0.34)] Synopsys (SNPS) Is Up 17.7% After New AI Chip-Design Alliances With OpenAI And Amazon
item.description:
Sentiment: AMZN Bullish (+0.34)
Synopsys (SNPS) has seen a 17.7% increase in its stock price following new AI chip-design alliances with OpenAI and Amazon. These collaborations, including co-developing the GPT-Synopsys chip-design model and accelerating custom chip engineering, position Synopsys as a key infrastructure provider for AI-driven semiconductor design. While the partnerships could strengthen demand for Synopsys' AI-enabled tools, investors should be aware of the company's rich earnings multiple and tight expectations.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.31)] Teradyne Introduces Titan HP Platform with Burn-In Capabilities for Advanced AI Data Center Devices
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.31)
Teradyne, Inc. has announced the Titan HP platform, a new system with enhanced burn-in capabilities for advanced AI data center devices. This platform optimizes reliability stress functions by holding each device at its target junction temperature while running a realistic workload, offering an improvement over traditional burn-in methods. The Titan HP aims to reduce test costs, improve time to market, and provide better data on every shipped device for high-power AI silicon.

item.title: [NVDA Neutral (+0.14)] Applied Materials and Intel team up on AI chip R&D at EPIC Center
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Neutral (+0.14)
Applied Materials (AMAT) and Intel (INTC) have announced a collaboration to accelerate the development of next-generation chipmaking technologies for AI computing. This joint effort will involve work at Applied Materials' EPIC Center in Silicon Valley and Intel's research campus in Hillsboro, Oregon, focusing on advancements in transistors, interconnects, and advanced packaging. The goal is to shorten development cycles and accelerate the path from research to high-volume manufacturing for AI workloads.

item.title: [NVDA Neutral (+0.14)] Eco Wave Power CEO to present at NIBA investment conference By Investing.com
item.description:

Eco Wave Power Global AB's CEO, Inna Braverman, is scheduled to present at the National Investment Banking Association's 153rd Investment Conference. She will discuss the company's business strategy, growth opportunities, and current projects, including those in Israel, the Port of Los Angeles, Portugal, Taiwan, and India. The presentation will also highlight the increasing global demand for renewable electricity, partly fueled by the expansion of AI and digital infrastructure.

item.title: [AMZN Neutral (+0.11)] Constellation Energy stock outlook analysis after 20 year nuclear deal with Google
item.description:
Sentiment: AMZN Neutral (+0.11)
Constellation Energy (CEG) has secured a 20-year nuclear power deal with Google (GOOGL), providing long-term revenue visibility. While this agreement validates the demand for reliable nuclear power and strengthens Constellation's strategic position, the stock's current price might already reflect much of this positive news. Investors should be aware that significant earnings benefits from the upgraded capacity aren't expected until 2028, making the near-term outlook valuation-sensitive despite the strategically bullish long-term prospects.

item.title: [AAPL Bearish (-0.23), MSFT Bullish (+0.26)] Apple (AAPL) Trading Above Analyst Targets as Memory Costs Crimp Margin Outlook
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Bearish (-0.23), MSFT Bullish (+0.26)
Apple (AAPL) stock has surpassed average analyst price targets despite rising memory costs impacting gross margins. The company is set to launch its first folding phone, the iPhone Duo, priced at $1,999, which will test market sentiment and the new CEO's leadership. Analysts are divided, with some concerned about increasing hardware costs and others seeing Apple as a premium services and AI platform.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.21)] Should You Buy Verizon Communications Stock Before Oct. 26?
item.description:

With its Q3 earnings release approaching on Oct. 26, the stock is trading at a low forward earnings multiple and offers an attractive 6.2% dividend yield, making it a potential value buy for long-term investors despite concerns about interest rate impacts.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.54)] Should You Buy Verizon Communications Stock Before Oct. 26?
item.description:

Verizon Communications (NYSE: VZ) stock has been declining due to interest rate hikes, but its upcoming Q3 earnings report could provide a boost. Despite general bearish sentiment towards telecom stocks, Verizon has rallied after past earnings reports this year due to strong performance and increased guidance. The stock is currently trading at a low valuation with an attractive 6.2% dividend yield, making it a potential value buy for long-term investors, even if interest rate concerns continue to weigh on the stock in the short term.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.32)] The 10-Year Treasury Just Hit a 24-Year High. Here's Why AGNC Just Hit a 52-Week Low Because of It.
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.32)
The 10-year Treasury yield has surged to a 24-year high, driven by inflation, the federal deficit, and AI infrastructure spending, significantly impacting income-focused investments like AGNC Investment. AGNC, a mortgage REIT, has seen its shares drop to a 52-week low, pushing its dividend yield above 16.5% due to narrowing investment spreads. The article highlights that continued interest rate hikes could further pressure AGNC's stock and potentially affect its dividend sustainability, making the upcoming earnings call crucial for investors.

item.title: [AAPL Bullish (+0.21)] Apple will reportedly hold not one but two sets of product launches this month
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Bullish (+0.21)
Apple is rumored to be holding two separate product launch events in October. The first, around October 13th, is expected to focus on smart-home products like a HomePad and potentially new Apple TV and HomePod mini. A second wave of announcements in the final week of October is anticipated to unveil new Mac models, possibly including the M6 MacBook Pro, M6 iMac, and a MacBook with an OLED touchscreen.

item.title: [AAPL Neutral (+0.15)] Skyworks Solutions (NASDAQ:SWKS) Stock Rating Upgraded by B. Riley Financial
item.description:

B. Riley Financial has upgraded Skyworks Solutions (NASDAQ:SWKS) to a "buy" rating from "neutral," setting a new price target of $107, which implies a 27.5% upside. Despite this upgrade, the broader analyst sentiment remains cautious with a consensus "hold" rating and an average price target of $77.37. The company's recent quarterly earnings beat estimates, though revenue saw a slight decline.

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.23), NVDA Neutral (+0.11)] Microsoft May Be Winning Enterprise AI, but When Does the Stock Catch Up?
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bullish (+0.23), NVDA Neutral (+0.11)
Microsoft has consistently beaten earnings estimates for six consecutive quarters, yet its stock price has remained stagnant over the past year. Jim Cramer suggests that enterprise boards are defaulting to Microsoft for AI solutions due to trust and governance, evident in a significant increase in commercial backlog. The upcoming Azure earnings report, specifically its constant-currency growth figure, is expected to either validate the recent stock rally or confirm market skepticism.

item.title: [AMZN Bullish (+0.33)] Amazon adds 190 MW. Constellation Energy stock gains 2.52 percent
item.description:
Sentiment: AMZN Bullish (+0.33)
Amazon and Constellation Energy announced a 20-year power purchase agreement for 690 megawatts, including 190 megawatts of new nuclear capacity at the Calvert Cliffs plant. This deal, valued at over $3 billion, led to a 2.52% gain for Constellation Energy's stock. The company also raised its full-year 2026 adjusted operating earnings guidance, reflecting strong current-year performance and improved long-term revenue visibility.

item.title: [AMZN Neutral (+0.15)] BullFrog AI reports milestone progress in depression drug discovery
item.description:
Sentiment: AMZN Neutral (+0.15)
BullFrog AI Holdings, Inc. announced significant progress in its commercial program with a top-five global pharmaceutical company, identifying novel therapeutic targets for major depressive disorder (MDD) using its AI and machine learning platform. The company is also applying its technology to discover drug targets for other neuropsychiatric conditions like schizophrenia and bipolar disorder. BullFrog AI operates three platform components: bfPREP, bfLEAP, and bfARENAS, though financial terms and the partner's identity were not disclosed.

item.title: [TSM Neutral (+0.13)] Report: Taipower Asked Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing to "Take Over a Power Plant"? Taipower Says Only Conceptual Discussions, No Formal Proposal
item.description:
Sentiment: TSM Neutral (+0.13)
Reports surfaced that Taipower suggested Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing (TSMC) either take over or fund the construction of a power plant due to rapidly increasing electricity demand from the semiconductor and AI industries. Taipower clarified that these discussions are only conceptual, with no formal proposals or policy reviews initiated. Taipower emphasizes its evolving role from a mere power supplier to an integral part of the tech supply chain, advocating for a "joint decision-making mechanism" with the tech sector to align power generation investments with industry needs.

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.25)] Microsoft Caps Copilot Business at 4,000 Credits per User by Default
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bullish (+0.25)
Microsoft is delaying the default implementation of usage-based billing for new Copilot Business subscriptions until December 1st, instead of November 2nd, to allow resellers more time to prepare. The new model caps users at 4,000 Copilot Credits per month, costing $0.01 each, and is a strategic shift towards "per seat plus consumption" billing. This change aims to improve gross margins, which have been impacted by increased Copilot usage, mirroring the success seen with GitHub Copilot's margin improvements after it moved to usage-based billing.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.49)] These information technology stocks earn A+ growth grades heading into Q4
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.49)
As Q4 2026 begins, the information technology sector, driven by AI advancements, data-center investments, and semiconductor demand, is being evaluated for growth characteristics. This article highlights 19 IT stocks across various sub-sectors that have achieved an A+ Growth Grade, indicating exceptional growth prospects. Several of these companies, including NVIDIA and Micron Technology, also hold Strong Buy Quant Ratings.

item.title: [NVDA Neutral (+0.10)] Goldman Sachs Adjusts Price Target on Aptiv to $61 From $71, Keeps Buy Rating
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Neutral (+0.10)
Goldman Sachs has adjusted its price target for Aptiv (APTV) to $61, down from $71, while maintaining a Buy rating on the stock. This follows a previous adjustment by Goldman Sachs in August, where they lowered the target to $71 from $82, also with a Buy rating. The article also lists several other analyst adjustments to Aptiv's price target and ratings from August, indicating a broader trend of recalibrating expectations for the company.

item.title: [AMZN Bullish (+0.28)] Google signs $4.3 billion nuclear power deal with Constellation
item.description:
Sentiment: AMZN Bullish (+0.28)
Google and Constellation Energy have signed a 20-year power purchase agreement for 890 megawatts of new nuclear capacity, with Constellation investing over $4.3 billion for upgrades at 11 nuclear units. This deal, aimed at strengthening the PJM Interconnection grid, also includes a 15-year energy supply agreement for an additional 2,700 megawatts and a five-year technology agreement for Constellation to deploy Google Cloud services. The initiative follows a similar deal Constellation made with Amazon and is structured to add new grid supply without increasing costs for residential customers.

item.title: [AAPL Bullish (+0.26), NVDA Bullish (+0.32), TSM Bullish (+0.45)] Central Pacific Bank Trust Division Purchases 2,336 Shares of Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Ltd. $TSM

(TSM) by 31.2% in the third quarter, bringing its total holdings to 9,815 shares valued at $4.48 million. The company is experiencing positive sentiment due to strong AI-chip demand and potential talks with Elon Musk about a "Terafab" facility in Texas, though risks include margin pressure from 2-nanometer production and overseas factory expansion, as well as a reduced quarterly dividend.

item.title: [MSFT Neutral (+0.14), NVDA Neutral (+0.14)] OpenAI and Synopsys partner to build "GPT-Synopsys" for autonomous chip design — specialized AI model will operate EDA tools, allowing engineers to deliver more sophisticated chips faster
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Neutral (+0.14), NVDA Neutral (+0.14)
OpenAI and Synopsys have partnered to develop "GPT-Synopsys," a specialized AI model for autonomous semiconductor design. This model will integrate OpenAI's AI capabilities with Synopsys's EDA tools and agentic AI, allowing engineers to delegate design tasks to AI agents, potentially leading to more sophisticated chips and faster development. The partnership involves OpenAI licensing Synopsys tools to develop the model, which will run on OpenAI's infrastructure, with joint product release and revenue sharing planned.

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.49), NVDA Bullish (+0.41)] Jim Cramer Says Microsoft Is One of AI’s ‘Big Winners’ As Copilot Momentum Builds
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bullish (+0.49), NVDA Bullish (+0.41)
Jim Cramer highlighted Microsoft as a major AI leader, strong enough to counteract rising interest rates, especially with its Copilot AI platform gaining momentum. Microsoft is strategically expanding Copilot beyond a simple chatbot into a comprehensive AI operating system, with new functionalities like Home, Code, and Autopilot, and is investing heavily in data centers to support surging AI demand. Oppenheimer analyst Brian Schwartz upgraded Microsoft's price target to $570, citing increased engagement, retention, and monetization opportunities across Azure and Microsoft 365 due to the new Copilot strategy.

item.title: [MSFT Neutral (+0.12), NVDA Bullish (+0.47), AMZN Neutral (+0.13)] World's most-valuable company Nvidia now runs 'much more like a family business': Meet Jensen Huang's son-in-law and children who may lead it next
item.category: MSFT Neutral (+0.12), NVDA Bullish (+0.47), AMZN Neutral (+0.13)
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Neutral (+0.12), NVDA Bullish (+0.47), AMZN Neutral (+0.13)
Nvidia, the world's most valuable company, is increasingly being influenced by Jensen Huang's family members in key leadership roles. His son-in-law, Nico Caprez, has rapidly ascended to an important executive position, managing significant deals with cloud providers, while his daughter, Madison Huang, leads marketing for Nvidia's robotics initiatives. This has led some employees to describe the company as operating "much more like a family business."

item.title: [MSFT Neutral (+0.12)] FY2026 Earnings Estimate for Fortinet Issued By Scotiabank
item.description:

This revision comes after Fortinet exceeded expectations in its latest quarter, reporting an EPS of $0.90 against an anticipated $0.75 and revenue of $2.05 billion versus $1.89 billion. Despite these positive indicators, Fortinet maintains a "Sector Perform" rating from Scotiabank with a $163 price target, while the overall analyst consensus remains "Hold" with an average target of $152.79.

item.title: [AAPL Neutral (+0.02)] Assessing Apple's Performance Against Competitors In Technology Hardware, Storage & Peripherals Industry
item.description:

The company demonstrates strong profitability and cash flow, with high ROE, EBITDA, and gross profit, but its revenue growth is slower than the industry average.

item.title: [AAPL Neutral (+0.05)] Apple Intelligence Comes With a Very Annoying Feature. How to Turn It Off
item.description:

While Writing Tools can proofread, rewrite, summarize, or change the tone of text, the issue is its persistent icon appearing in every text field whether desired or not. This constant presence is seen as intrusive and an example of tech companies pushing their AI features.

item.title: [MSFT Bullish (+0.21), AMZN Bullish (+0.28)] Google signs 20-year nuclear deal with Constellation Energy to power AI buildout
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bullish (+0.21), AMZN Bullish (+0.28)
Google has signed a 20-year, $4.3 billion deal with Constellation Energy to secure 890 megawatts of nuclear power for its AI build-out. This agreement will fund upgrades at six existing nuclear plants and utilize Google's Gemini Enterprise software for operational efficiency. This move reflects a broader trend among Big Tech companies, including Amazon, Microsoft, and Meta, to invest in nuclear energy to meet their growing power demands.

item.description:

item.title: [AMZN Bullish (+0.34)] Constellation Energy (CEG) Shares Just Moved, So What Is Driving Attention?
